name: General Translation
description: General Translation is a full-stack localization suite that translates entire React and Next.js components — not just strings — with a simple <T> wrapper. There is no refactoring into dictionaries: you write your content and let GT handle the rest, with a CLI tool for continuous localization and an AI agent (Locadex) for automating i18n across complex codebases.
highlights: Translate whole components with a <T> wrapper instead of string dictionaries
First-class packages for React, Next.js, Sanity, and a pure-JavaScript i18n core
CLI for continuous localization plus build plugins for webpack, Vite, Rollup, and esbuild
Locadex AI agent and an MCP server to automate i18n in complex codebases
curatorNote: Stayed under 1.1k stars for over a year, then pushed onto the in-window trending list in July 2026.
